description: Offline approximate stage allocations. Crop-specific four-stage percentages are taken from FAO Water Management training manual Table 7 or FAO Annex II Table 4.11 where available. Milestone sub-stages are interpolations, not field observations.

crops.source: FAO Annex II Table 4.11, Pearl millet row (60–100 day growth cycle).
crops.scope: Stage allocation reference for pearl millet; other millet types vary. Dates use the selected variety duration.

crops.source: FAO Annex II Table 4.11, Wheat row (100–190 day growth cycle).
crops.scope: General wheat estimate; cultivar, sowing date and temperature alter stage lengths.

crops.source: FAO Annex II Table 4.11, Barley row (90–180 day growth cycle).
crops.scope: General barley estimate; cultivar, sowing date and temperature alter stage lengths.

crops.source: FAO Annex II Table 4.11, rice (dryland and wetland) rows.
crops.scope: Broad rice estimate; variety, nursery period and transplanting method change dates.

crops.source: FAO Annex II Table 4.11, lowland maize row.
crops.scope: Lowland maize planning allocation; grain and sweet maize durations differ.

crops.source: Approximate oilseed planning split using FAO initial, development, mid-season and late-season stage definitions; mustard-specific durations are not separated in the cited tables.
crops.scope: Lower-confidence stage estimate; verify with the selected variety and local KVK.

crops.source: FAO Annex II Table 4.11, white potato row.
crops.scope: White potato planning allocation; cultivar and temperature affect tuber development.

crops.source: FAO Annex II Table 4.11, sugarcane row.
crops.scope: Broad long-duration sugarcane allocation; ratoon and planting systems change timing.

crops.source: FAO Annex II Table 4.11, cotton row.
crops.scope: Broad cotton planning allocation; variety and picking pattern affect crop duration.

crops.source: FAO Water Management training manual Table 7, tomato transplanted 140-day example (15, 40, 60, 25 days), converted to percentages.
crops.scope: Transplant-based planning example; nursery days are outside this field timeline.

crops.source: Approximate pulse proxy based on FAO Water Management training manual dry-bean stage allocations (15, 25, 35, 20 days at the 95-day example).
crops.scope: Pulse proxy, not chickpea cultivar-specific. Verify stage dates locally.

crops.source: FAO Annex II Table 4.11, soybean row.
crops.scope: Broad soybean estimate; cultivar, photoperiod and planting date affect timing.
